name: Draft On Level Up
description: The choose-one-of-three that turns leveling into build-crafting. When progression.leveledUp fires, this component offers a small draw from the run's draft pool — stat boons, new verbs, synergies — and applies the pick immediately, because a level-up reward queued for later is a level-up reward forgotten. Options are drawn without replacement so one level never offers the same boon twice. It owns the offer and the application. It does not own when leveling happens — progression.xp_leveling decides that — and it does not own the pool's contents, which are run content declared as data. The card draft after combat is ui.draft_reward_screen's job; the two are siblings on purpose, since combat drafts grow the deck while level-up drafts grow the build, and conflating them makes both screens worse.

inputs.name: draftPool
inputs.description: Boon ids eligible this run, as data. Required: a level-up with an empty pool is a promise the run cannot keep.

inputs.name: choicesPerDraft
inputs.description: Options shown per level. Three balances commitment against regret; two reads as forced, four reads as homework.

inputs.name: allowReroll
inputs.description: Whether the player may redraw the offer. A reroll button devalues commitment; if a design enables it, it should charge for it.

outputs.name: lastOffer
outputs.description: The boon ids most recently offered, kept for UI restore after interruption.

outputs.name: draftsTaken
outputs.description: Drafts resolved this run — the build's spine, countable at a glance in ui.death_summary.
